name: moa_config_slot_problem
notes: MoA preset slot validation ladder (src/hermes_cli/moa_config_pure.c::moa_slot_problem vs LIVE hermes_cli/moa_config.py::_slot_problem). Input encoding: '!' = non-object slot, else 'provider|model'. Ladder: not-object / both-empty / provider-empty / model-empty / moa-case-insensitive. Non-string JSON provider/model values (C treats as '', LIVE str()s them) are excluded from the agreed sub-contract.
